rationale: The mobile-AM defect claim is a concrete instance of the processing-structure-properties chain: mechanical disturbance during processing introduces defects that alter structure and degrade adhesion/performance. The meta-principle provides the general materials-science framework, and the claim specializes it to mobile additive manufacturing under terrain-induced vibration.
